report.summary: Reviewed envelope.py chunk 3: defines LOCAL_TO_GEN_AI mapping and gen_ai_attributes() function; documents CONVERTED_PRODUCERS and UNCONVERTED_PRODUCERS tables. All local claims are verifiable. No external file changes or tests.
risks: LOCAL_TO_GEN_AI | medium | Mapping keys include 'model', 'vendor', 'provider', 'endpoint' which are not standard GenAI attribute names; may cause confusion if consumers expect OTel-style names. | Check if consumers handle these keys correctly.
gen_ai_attributes | low | Overrides use str(name).replace('__', '.') which could inadvertently transform keys containing double underscores. | Confirm no legitimate keys contain '__'.
UNCONVERTED_PRODUCERS | low | Contains many entries with detailed reasoning; if the code changes, this documentation may become stale. | Ensure a test enforces consistency with codebase.
CONVERTED_PRODUCERS | low | Only lists three modules; may be incomplete. | Verify that all actually converted producers are listed.
todos: Consider adding a test that ensures every producer is listed in either CONVERTED_PRODUCERS or UNCONVERTED_PRODUCERS.

handoff.purpose: Define GenAI attribute mapping and gen_ai_attributes function; document producer ledger tables.

symbols.name: LOCAL_TO_GEN_AI
symbols.note: Mapping from local model-call dict keys to GenAI attribute names. Contains keys: model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, input_tokens, output_tokens, vendor, provider, endpoint, finish_reason.

symbols.name: gen_ai_attributes
symbols.note: Transforms a meta dict and optional overrides into a dict of GenAI attributes using LOCAL_TO_GEN_AI mapping. Drops keys not in mapping, drops None values. Overrides use '__' as dot separator.

symbols.name: CONVERTED_PRODUCERS
symbols.note: Dictionary of producers that have been wired to produce trace IDs. Keys are module paths, values describe how trace is carried.

symbols.name: UNCONVERTED_PRODUCERS
symbols.note: Dictionary of producers not yet wired, with reasons. Includes run records, measurement artefacts, and non-run records.

claims.text: Keys absent from LOCAL_TO_GEN_AI are dropped rather than passed through
claims.why: Code iterates over meta items and only includes those where LOCAL_TO_GEN_AI.get(str(key)) is not None.

claims.text: None values are dropped: an attribute present-but-null is indistinguishable from a measured zero to most consumers.
claims.why: Both loops check 'if value is not None' before adding to output.

claims.text: Overrides use '__' as a separator for nested keys.
claims.why: Code does str(name).replace('__', '.') for override keys.

claims.text: CONVERTED_PRODUCERS lists producers wired end-to-end. The value is HOW the trace is carried.
claims.why: No code in this chunk verifies that these producers are actually wired; it's a documentation claim.

claims.text: UNCONVERTED_PRODUCERS lists producers NOT wired, each with the reason it is affordable to defer.
claims.why: No code in this chunk verifies that these producers are not wired; it's a documentation claim.

claims.text: tests/test_envelope_coverage.py fails when a producer appears in neither table
claims.why: The test file is not in this chunk.

observations.what: gen_ai_attributes function uses Mapping[str, Any] | None for meta parameter, but iterates over dict(meta or {}).items() which is type-safe.
LOCAL_TO_GEN_AI includes keys like 'model', 'vendor', 'provider', 'endpoint' which are not standard GenAI semantic convention attribute names (e.g., gen_ai.request.model).
The UNCONVERTED_PRODUCERS dictionary contains very detailed reasoning for each module, which may become outdated if the code changes.
